traits.flower_merosity.note: Hooker, Student's Flora, 3rd ed. (1884), Circaea (genus account), p. 159 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): calyx limb 2-parted, petals 2, stamens 2; Bentham (p. 154) the same.

traits.stamens.note: Hooker, Student's Flora, 3rd ed. (1884), Circaea (genus account), p. 159 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): stamens 2.

traits.petal_apex.note: Hooker, Student's Flora, 3rd ed. (1884), Circaea (genus account), p. 159 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): petals 2, obcordate (notched at the tip); Wikipedia 'Circaea lutetiana' (read 2026-10-17): 2 notched petals.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Bentham and Hooker, Handbook of the British Flora (1908 printing), Circaea, p. 154 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): leaves opposite, on rather long stalks.

traits.inflorescence.note: Hooker, Student's Flora, 3rd ed. (1884), Circaea, p. 159 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): lax erect racemes, terminal and lateral, stalked, usually without bracts.

traits.carpels.note: Hooker, Student's Flora, 3rd ed. (1884), Circaea, p. 159 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): fruit 2-celled, each cell with one seed.
